cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an interactive coastal-light festival exhibit built on an orbital habitat's indoor seaside promenade — she plays the lighthouse keeper for the exhibit; a small far-future noodle bar inside an orbital passenger terminal — she takes a quiet meal after travelling; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; her crew cabin aboard a starship — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a desert oasis at golden hour — kneeling on the ground; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; her living room with a deep sofa — lying on her front; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground
